apps.name: CONTINUUM
apps.subtitle: Work, life, and a little chaos.
apps.localizedDescription: A native workspace with a sourced profile from your private Zay — Continuity website. Connect selected non-sensitive categories to seed preferences and project context for Calibrate. Refresh source changes on the signed-in website, then sync the profile to your phone. Source-grounded questions, Deep Dive, reviewed answers, cloud drafts and AI Spark. Authoritative approvals remain in Continuity. Unsigned for Feather; iOS 16.4 or later.

versions.localizedDescription: New native Continuity profile with source text, revisions and refresh controls. Selected categories seed initial calibration; signed-in website refreshes preserve scope exclusions and can be paused. Source refresh requires opening the private website. 48 core tests, 22 native tests, TypeScript and macOS device build passed. Physical iPhone runtime remains unverified.

Cloud-connected release with source-grounded Calibrate, adaptive Deep Dive, answer review and AI Spark. Fixes cloud-aware home counts and AI help. Live website sign-in, authorized context import, cloud answer persistence, real AI generation, favorites and idempotent pending proposals verified. 43 root tests, 21 native tests, TypeScript and macOS device archive passed. Physical iPhone acceptance remains pending.

Cloud auth and sync; explicit scoped context import on the private website; source-grounded server Calibrate and adaptive Deep Dive; reviewable targeted proposals; AI Spark and favorites. 43 root tests, 21 native tests, TypeScript and macOS Release device build passed. Physical iPhone acceptance is pending. Rule-based question selection; no automatic access to private website sessions.

First native iOS preview: five screens, persistent Quick Calibrate drafts, adaptive follow-ups, review/edit/skip, and Spark history/favorites. 19 native tests, 31 existing tests, TypeScript, Expo Doctor, Release device/simulator builds, and two iOS simulator flows passed. Physical iPhone installation, signing, haptics, and VoiceOver remain untested. No live Continuity or AI connection.

apps.name: Epic Battles of History
apps.subtitle: Portrait 3v3 history brawler
apps.localizedDescription: Historical figures brawl in a portrait 3v3 fighting game. This unsigned test build is for Feather on iOS 15.0 or later.

versions.localizedDescription:
Build v012, recording fixed. The phone shows it as version 0.0.12 (13). It installs over v011 and over v012 build 12.

Fixed
- Build 12 started with the recorder switched off, so matches and Training recorded nothing and FLAG notes had no video or mic. Build 13 is the same code with the recorder on.

New
- Training records the whole session, from the moment you enter until you leave, as one recording uploaded in parts under 10 MB.
- Training lets you pick both YOU and the DUMMY before you start.
- A match intro plays on the first match of each session. Settings has a MATCH INTRO switch to turn it off.
- FLAG is quicker, and a voice note records only while you hold MIC on the open flag.
- When your Special meter is full (Time Out for Hayes), the meter and the Special button give a clear ready cue.
- Fighters have ink outlines and cel shading, hits flash, and a fresh menu starts on Mirrormere.

Changed
- Specials hit at size 65 (was 55). You can still change it in Test Mode.
- Play and Settings respond to the first tap after a fresh install.

Known issues: Not checked on a phone yet. Washington's Special muzzle flash still shows behind him (fix in progress). Recording through to the result screen and the new knockback are not in this build.

Build v012. The phone shows it as version 0.0.12 (12), matching the build name. It installs over v011.

New
- Training records the whole session, from the moment you enter until you leave, as one recording uploaded in parts under 10 MB.
- Training lets you pick both YOU and the DUMMY before you start.
- A match intro plays on the first match of each session. Settings has a MATCH INTRO switch to turn it off.
- FLAG is quicker, and a voice note records only while you hold MIC on the open flag.
- When your Special meter is full (Time Out for Hayes), the meter and the Special button give a clear ready cue.
- Fighters have ink outlines and cel shading, hits flash, and a fresh menu starts on Mirrormere.

Changed
- Specials hit at size 65 (was 55). You can still change it in Test Mode.
- Play and Settings respond to the first tap after a fresh install.

Known issues: Not checked on a phone yet. Washington's Special muzzle flash still shows behind him (fix in progress). Recording through to the result screen and the new knockback are not in this build.

Build v011. The phone shows it as version 0.0.11 (11), matching the build name.

Before you install: delete EBH from your phone once. v010 showed 0.0.24, so iOS may refuse to put 0.0.11 over it.

New
- On every K.O. the camera glides into a front shot of the winner, then cuts to a high shot of the fallen fighter and glides back as the next fighter comes in.
- The NEXT card waits through the winner shot and appears below the fallen fighter.
- The home screen shows the EBH icon (Hayes on red) instead of the default Defold icon.

Changed
- The version on the phone now matches the build name: v011 = 0.0.11, v012 = 0.0.12.

Known issues: Not checked on a phone yet, including how the K.O. cut feels in real time. The first frame of the fallen shot can catch the body mid-fall.

Build v010. The phone shows it as version 0.0.24 (24); from v011 on, the version matches the build name (v011 = 0.0.11).

New
- The K.O. now reads cleanly: a small burst, a NEXT card at the edge that names the incoming fighter, and a slow camera push-in.
- Clean hits push the target back; heavy hits push further.
- HEAVY and a full Special pulse when they are ready.

Changed
- A side swipe next to a wall steps the other way instead of doing nothing, and the screen says why when it can't move.
- The camera holds steady, keeps headroom and glides when fighters swap.
- Only PARRY, PARRIED and COUNTER appear as words; BLOCK, MISS, DODGE and EVADED are gone.
- The ranged CPU keeps moving while its shot recharges.
- A tagged-in fighter lands about 2 m away instead of nose to nose.

Fixed
- Luther standing still when swiped toward the near wall.
- The K.O. banner no longer covers the ENEMY label, and damage numbers stay below it.

Known issues: This build has not been checked on a phone yet. The installed app shows the default Defold icon on the home screen; the EBH icon goes into the app itself from the next build.

New
- Pick your team before a match, and pick who you play in Training.
- Switch arenas from the arena picker.
- Luther fights with his own model, hammer and Door Service Special.
- Rate each match and flag a moment with a note; full matches are recorded for review.

Changed
- Team select moves on by itself once your team is set.
- A tagged-in fighter runs in along the floor.
- Input buffering and defence against Specials are reworked.
- The Flag button sits in the top-right corner.

Fixed
- The K.O. hand-off to the next fighter no longer pops.
- A black-screen bug from an earlier test build.

Known issues: This build has not been checked on a phone yet.

New
- Overload Grip has a visible overhand windup.

Changed
- Light hits, heavy hits and blocks use smaller contact effects.
- The knockout burst is smaller and the K.O.! banner sits above the fighters.

Fixed
- The orange grab warning clears when the windup ends or a Special interrupts it.
- Portrait Special shots leave more room for fighters to recoil.

Known issues: An ordinary throw can still crop a fighter during recovery.

apps.name: Sample Size
apps.subtitle: References and decisions for your clothing brand.
apps.localizedDescription: Clothing-brand research and review with Grailed and Depop search, full photo galleries, followed searches and a shared Brand Review workspace. Saved inspiration, exact decisions/notes/tags, collections, image notes, discussions, reference and casting files, revisions, drafts, preferences and inbox state sync while active or on return. Design ratings and weighted criteria retain their exact-version sync. Tag-based ranking; no visual AI training or closed-app background refresh. Unsigned for Feather; iOS 16.4 or later.
